name: IVR
tagline: International Association Representing Interests in Inland Navigation
hero_kpi_rationale: Organisation à but non lucratif sans données financières publiques. L'engagement des membres et la participation aux congrès annuels constituent les principaux indicateurs de performance disponibles dans le rapport d'activité.

kpis.explanation: Number of members and stakeholders participating in the annual IVR Congress
kpis.signal: Strong member engagement and international participation
kpis.description: Le Congrès annuel 2024 à Francfort a accueilli 225 participants représentant 11 pays européens. Cet événement demeure le point culminant annuel de l'organisation.

kpis.explanation: Number of European countries represented in the IVR membership and participation
kpis.description: Au Congrès 2024, IVR a rassemblé des représentants de 11 pays européens différents, confirmant sa portée géographique et son rôle de plateforme internationale.

kpis.name_fr: Participants au Colloque de Prévention des Sinistres
kpis.explanation: Number of industry professionals attending the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium event
kpis.signal: Successful launch of new flagship educational and networking event
kpis.description: Le premier Colloque de Prévention des Sinistres, organisé en novembre 2024 à Anvers, a attiré environ 80 participants professionnels issus de Belgique, des Pays-Bas et d'Allemagne, représentant les assureurs, courtiers, experts et armateurs.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related digital technologies in the 2024 annual report. IVR focuses on regulatory alignment, technical standards, and industry knowledge exchange.
evidence: No references to AI, machine learning, or algorithmic capabilities
Focus on traditional committee work (ZKR, CESNI) and standards harmonization
Digitalization mentioned only in context of professional qualifications and regulatory frameworks, not as core organizational capability

_validation: Corrected sector from 'Information Technology' to 'Trade Associations & Professional Services' - IVR is a non-profit industry association, not an IT company
Corrected subsector from 'IT Services' to 'Industry Associations'
Corrected tagline to accurately describe IVR as an international association for inland navigation interests
Removed invalid rank indicators (≈ #N/A, ...) and replaced with proper N/A values
Replaced generic, unavailable KPIs with actual data points extracted from annual report: Congress attendance (225 persons), Member countries (11), Loss Prevention Colloquium attendance (80 persons)
Removed hallucinated KPIs: Gross Margin, Operating Margin, and Headcount - these metrics do not exist in the source document and are inappropriate for a non-profit association
Updated hero_kpi to 'Annual Membership Engagement' with rationale explaining why financial metrics are unavailable for non-profit organizations
Added specific dates for data collection (2024-05-17 for Congress, 2024-11-04 for Colloquium)
Corrected KPI units and values to reflect actual source data
Removed em-dashes from French rationales per instructions
Added proper history arrays with year, value, and unit for each KPI
